instructions.primary_message: Line an 8-inch square baking dish using two sheets of parchment paper (arranging them perpendicularly, one on top of the other). When pressed into the baking dish, the paper should come up all four sides of the dish. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl, then measure out 1 tsp juice and set aside for a later step. (Reserve remaining lemon juice for another use.)
Roughly chop pistachios and set aside for later use.
Place milk and ghee in a large skillet. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring often with a silicone spatula, until the ghee is melted, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole milk
⅓ cup ghee (clarified butter)

instructions.primary_message: Add sugar to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until just dissolved, 1-2 minutes more.

Reduce heat to low and gradually add milk powder in a thin steady stream, stirring continuously, until incorporated. (Go slowly to prevent lumps.) Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture has thickened slightly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¾ cups non-fat dry milk powder

instructions.primary_message: Crush saffron threads with your fingers and add to the skillet, along with lemon juice, cardamom, and salt. Stir well to combine, then continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens to a pudding-like consistency that pulls away from the bottom of the skillet as you drag the spatula through it, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pinch saffron threads
1 tsp cardamom, ground
1 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer milk mixture to the baking dish and, using the silicone spatula, spread out in an even layer. Sprinkle pistachios over top and gently press them into the barfi. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and place in the fridge until cooled and set, about 1 hour.
Once set, remove barfi from the fridge. Remove parchment, transfer to a cutting board, and slice into squares.
To serve, arrange barfi on a platter. Enjoy!
